The appeal path, quoted from POL-GEN-04

Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 5.10 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

The judge's explanation, as written

To both parties. This was a metered RYDE_X trip, TRP-02857, driven on 2026-09-09. The booked optimal route was 14.4 km (EV-TRIP-02857). The governing measurement is the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02857, weight 1.0), which records 19.12 km against the booked optimal, an excess of 4.72 km, or 32.78%. Both POL-RD-01 establishment tests pass (above 0.8 km and above 20%), so the deviation is ESTABLISHED; neither materiality gate (8.0 km, 50%) is met, so it is not a MATERIAL deviation. The trace itself is unimpaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07: 151 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, no gaps and no jump over 500 m, so the deviation rests on the trace alone (POL-RD-08(b)) and no POL-RD-07(ii)/POL-RD-10(3) corroboration question arises. The triad EV-TRIP-02857 / EV-GPS-02857 / EV-FARE-02857 all carry trip_id TRP-02857 with matching timing, so POL-RD-08(a) is satisfied. No exculpatory clause applies: EV-CHAT-02857 has 0 messages (POL-RD-04 has no instruction to test), no pickup or dropoff amendment exists (POL-RD-05), and the vehicle is RYDE_X with no pooled itinerary (POL-RD-12). POL-RD-11 does not apply because the fare is METERED with quoted_fare_sgd null, so POL-RD-02 runs. The arithmetic, read off EV-FARE-02857: recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 14.4 + 0.28 x 19.4) x 1.0 surge multiplier (read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier) + 0.80 platform fee = 20.832; charged_total 25.93; refund = 25.93 - 20.832 = 5.098, rounded UP to SGD 5.10. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis (so not NO_ACTION) and 19.66% of charged_total, far below the 90% share that would make it a full refund. No ERP, toll or airport surcharge lines exist in the ledger, so no POL-RD-09 pass-through or billing-integrity correction is added. On the rider's stated ground: the 'six deviation flags' cited in the claim is driver_profile.prior_deviation_flags, a lifetime counter that POL-GEN-01 marks CONTEXT ONLY and forbids as a ground of decision; the counter POL-RD-06 names, deviation_flags_90d, is 0 against 260 completed trips in the trailing window, so no repeat pattern is established and neither the POL-RD-06(b) full-refund uplift nor the POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral is available. On the driver's explanation of 'Traffic.': no traffic advisory covers this trip - EV-ADVIS-02857-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT - and under POL-RD-13 that assertion cites no artifact, so it is a gap in the bundle rather than a contradiction, POL-RD-03 cannot be run, and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. No POL-RD-10 escalation trigger fires. Two rider claims were discarded before the debate: both cited the impaired advisory EV-ADVIS-02857-01 (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) without disclosing the impairment as POL-GEN-02(1) requires. The monetary effect (SGD 5.10) does not exceed the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so this provisional ruling is executed automatically subject to appeal under POL-GEN-04. The 25.93 charged stands except for the 5.10 returned to the rider. The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

evidence EV-TRIP-02857, EV-GPS-02857, EV-FARE-02857 · clauses POL-RD-08

The driver advocate

kept The rider's demand for a full refund is built on the wrong field. Her claim points to six deviation flags; that is driver_profile.prior_deviation_flags, a LIFETIME counter, and POL-GEN-01 marks that field as CONTEXT ONLY and forbids it as a ground of decision. The field POL-RD-06 actually names is driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d, which stands at 0 against 260 completed trips in the same 90-day window - below both limbs of the pattern test, which needs 3 or more flags, or a ratio of 0.05 or more on at least 40 completed trips. No repeat-deviation pattern is established, so the POL-RD-06(b) full-refund uplift and the POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral are both unavailable, and the rider's characterisation of the driver's record is contradicted by the only citable counter on the profile.

evidence EV-DPROF-02857 · clauses POL-GEN-01, POL-RD-06

kept On this trip's own trace the excess is 4.72 km and 32.78 percent of the 14.4 km booked optimal. That clears the POL-RD-01 establishment gates of 0.8 km and 20 percent, but sits below both materiality gates of 8.0 km and 50 percent, so the deviation is established and NOT material - and materiality is the only condition that engages the POL-RD-06 driver_profile check on this trip. The remedy is therefore confined to the POL-RD-02 arithmetic; a 4.72 km overshoot on a 25-minute metered trip is not the serial-misconduct case the rider's claim asserts.

evidence EV-GPS-02857, EV-TRIP-02857 · clauses POL-RD-01, POL-RD-06

kept The most the rider can recover is SGD 5.10, and the fare ledger proves it: recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 14.4 + 0.28 x 19.4) x 1.0 (the surge multiplier read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier) + 0.80 platform fee = 20.8320; refund = charged_total 25.93 - 20.8320 = 5.0980, rounded UP to SGD 5.10. That is 19.66 percent of charged_total - above the 0.50 de minimis, so a refund is due rather than NO_ACTION, but far below the 90 percent share that would convert it into a full refund. The rider's 9.50 figure has no line of the fare_breakdown behind it.

evidence EV-FARE-02857, EV-TRIP-02857 · clauses POL-RD-02, POL-RD-01

kept Nothing may be added on top of that figure. The ledger carries no ERP or toll lines at all - on-optimal-route and off-optimal-route ERP both 0.00 - and no airport surcharge on a trip that does not originate at an airport, so no POL-RD-09(4) billing-integrity correction and no POL-RD-09 pass-through refund arises. The billed distance of 19.1 km matches the trace's 19.12 km to within 20 metres, so the rider was not billed for distance the vehicle did not drive. The rider's recovery is the difference against the optimal route and nothing more.

evidence EV-FARE-02857, EV-GPS-02857 · clauses POL-RD-09, POL-RD-02

kept Nothing else in the bundle supports a remedy beyond that arithmetic. There is no chat log for the trip - 0 messages, so no rider instruction of any kind was recorded - and the bundle's only traffic advisory, EV-ADVIS-02857-01, is IMPAIRED BY ABSENCE: it carries no payload, its admissibility weight_multiplier is 0.0 and its issue code is MISSING_ARTIFACT with severity BLOCKING, so it can establish no fact for either party and the POL-RD-03 advisory comparison cannot be run on this record. The driver's contemporaneous account of traffic therefore stands unrefuted by any artifact in the bundle, but the driver does not ask the tribunal to assume a closure the record never records: the rider's case is the trace excess, and the trace excess is fully answered by the POL-RD-02 arithmetic figure.

To both parties. This was a metered RYDE_X trip, TRP-02857, driven on 2026-09-09. The booked optimal route was 14.4 km (EV-TRIP-02857). The governing measurement is the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02857, weight 1.0), which records 19.12 km against the booked optimal, an excess of 4.72 km, or 32.78%. Both POL-RD-01 establishment tests pass (above 0.8 km and above 20%), so the deviation is ESTABLISHED; neither materiality gate (8.0 km, 50%) is met, so it is not a MATERIAL deviation. The trace itself is unimpaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07: 151 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, no gaps and no jump over 500 m, so the deviation rests on the trace alone (POL-RD-08(b)) and no POL-RD-07(ii)/POL-RD-10(3) corroboration question arises. The triad EV-TRIP-02857 / EV-GPS-02857 / EV-FARE-02857 all carry trip_id TRP-02857 with matching timing, so POL-RD-08(a) is satisfied. No exculpatory clause applies: EV-CHAT-02857 has 0 messages (POL-RD-04 has no instruction to test), no pickup or dropoff amendment exists (POL-RD-05), and the vehicle is RYDE_X with no pooled itinerary (POL-RD-12). POL-RD-11 does not apply because the fare is METERED with quoted_fare_sgd null, so POL-RD-02 runs. The arithmetic, read off EV-FARE-02857: recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 14.4 + 0.28 x 19.4) x 1.0 surge multiplier (read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier) + 0.80 platform fee = 20.832; charged_total 25.93; refund = 25.93 - 20.832 = 5.098, rounded UP to SGD 5.10. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis (so not NO_ACTION) and 19.66% of charged_total, far below the 90% share that would make it a full refund. No ERP, toll or airport surcharge lines exist in the ledger, so no POL-RD-09 pass-through or billing-integrity correction is added. On the rider's stated ground: the 'six deviation flags' cited in the claim is driver_profile.prior_deviation_flags, a lifetime counter that POL-GEN-01 marks CONTEXT ONLY and forbids as a ground of decision; the counter POL-RD-06 names, deviation_flags_90d, is 0 against 260 completed trips in the trailing window, so no repeat pattern is established and neither the POL-RD-06(b) full-refund uplift nor the POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral is available. On the driver's explanation of 'Traffic.': no traffic advisory covers this trip - EV-ADVIS-02857-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT - and under POL-RD-13 that assertion cites no artifact, so it is a gap in the bundle rather than a contradiction, POL-RD-03 cannot be run, and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. No POL-RD-10 escalation trigger fires. Two rider claims were discarded before the debate: both cited the impaired advisory EV-ADVIS-02857-01 (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) without disclosing the impairment as POL-GEN-02(1) requires. The monetary effect (SGD 5.10) does not exceed the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so this provisional ruling is executed automatically subject to appeal under POL-GEN-04. The 25.93 charged stands except for the 5.10 returned to the rider.

This dispute is decided on the fare arithmetic, and it comes out at SGD 5.10 back to the rider. What happened. The trip (EV-TRIP-02857) was a metered RYDE_X ride. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02857) records 19.12 km driven against a booked optimal route of 14.4 km — an excess of 4.72 km, or 32.78%. POL-RD-01 makes the trace figure govern over the rounded trip_record.actual_distance_km, and that excess clears the two establishment gates (0.8 km and 20%) but sits below the two materiality gates (8.0 km and 50%), so the deviation is established but not material and the POL-RD-06 driver_profile check is not engaged. Nothing excuses the excess: the chat log is empty (no rider-requested detour under POL-RD-04), no pickup or dropoff was amended (POL-RD-05), the trip is not pooled (POL-RD-12), and no traffic advisory exists on file. The refund calculation under POL-RD-02, read from EV-FARE-02857 and EV-TRIP-02857: - charged_total: SGD 25.93 - recomputed_fare: (3.80 + 0.75 x 14.4 + 0.28 x 19.4) x 1.0 + 0.80 = SGD 20.832 (surge multiplier 1.0, read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier on EV-FARE-02857; the trip_record carries no such field and none was inferred) - refund: 25.93 - 20.832 = SGD 5.0980, rounded UP to SGD 5.10 That is above the SGD 0.50 de-minimis, and 19.66% of the charge, far below the 90% share that would convert the outcome to a full refund. So the result is a partial refund of SGD 5.10 — not the SGD 9.50 the rider asked for, and not the driver's request that nothing be paid. On the parties' points. The rider's demand for a full refund rests on 'six deviation flags'.
